# OBJECTIVE
This document reports on the **dataset organization** of the R1 experiment performed in the Fall of 2023 (completed Dec 2023) and R2 experiment performed in the Spring of 2024 (completed June 2024). Data represents the output of Miseq (R1) and NextSeq (R2) sequencing run of the Tri5 Mutant Microbiome project (Guixia Hao & Briana K. Whitaker & Nick Rhoades). 

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', include=FALSE} 
x<-c("ggplot2", "phyloseq", "dplyr", "RColorBrewer", "viridis",  "Biostrings")
lapply(x, require, character.only = TRUE)

#set seed
set.seed(128)

#Load functions
source("./code/multiplot.function.R")
`%nin%` = Negate(`%in%`)

# set ggplot2 theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=12)) 
theme_update(panel.grid.major=element_line(0), panel.grid.minor=element_line(0))

strain_col <- c("#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#1B9E77") #brewer.pal(3, name = "Dark2")

```

# Load Phyloseq
```{r}
load("./data/ps_r1b_curated.RData")
ps_r1b
load("./data/ps_r1f_curated.RData")
ps_r1f
load("./data/ps_r2b_curated.RData")
ps_r2b
load("./data/ps_r2f_curated.RData")
ps_r2f

```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# rename 2nd round samples to be intuitive sample ID
sample_names(ps_r2b) <- ps_r2b@sam_data$Sample_ID[match(sample_names(ps_r2b), rownames(ps_r2b@sam_data)) ]
sample_names(ps_r2f) <- ps_r2f@sam_data$Sample_ID[match(sample_names(ps_r2f), rownames(ps_r2f@sam_data)) ]

#keep only shared columns
colKeep <- c("Sample_ID", "I7_Index_ID", "I5_Index_ID", "Kingdom", "Chamber.Rep", "Strain", "Rep")
ps_r2b@sam_data <- ps_r2b@sam_data[,colKeep]
ps_r2f@sam_data <- ps_r2f@sam_data[,colKeep]

```

# Examine Mocks
```{r, results = 'hide'}
pos_r1b <- subset_samples(ps_r1b, Chamber.Rep == "Control")
pos_r1b <- filter_taxa(pos_r1b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )
pos_r1b@otu_table
sum(ps_r1b@otu_table[,"bASV34"])  #"bASV325", 
##ASV325 only in pos cont, but ASV34 also in  B-J-T5-1-4, B-H-Twn-12, B-H-Twn-10
ps_r1b@tax_table["bASV34",]  #both ASVs are Bacillus spp., the isolate used in pos cont is Whitaker Lab isolate A30, originally isolated from wheat awns on R2A media

pos_r1f <- subset_samples(ps_r1f, Chamber.Rep == "Control")
pos_r1f <- filter_taxa(pos_r1f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )
pos_r1f@otu_table 
pos_r1f@tax_table[colnames(pos_r1f@otu_table), "genus"]
# Bakker Fungal Mock Even mix of 19spp was used; but 24 tax not 19, and not really evenly amplified
# 1, 68 = alternaria, 205,268, 296 & 2 more unk Glomeromycota likely Rhizophagus; 
# 3 Fusarium ASVs & also supposed to be 3 fusarium in mock
# unk Ceratobasidiaceae likely Rhizoctonia, also an unk Ascomycota that might be one of the missing Ascos
# 58, 3793 Podila not in mock (this Podila might be the Mortierella in Bakker's orig); 
# 63 Starmerella not in mock, could this be a mis-IDed Candida?
# in mock but not amplified [Ascos: Neosartorya, Candida], [Zygos: Mortierella, Rhizomucor]

pos_r2b <- subset_samples(ps_r2b, Chamber.Rep == "")
pos_r2b <- filter_taxa(pos_r2b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )
pos_r2b@otu_table
pos_r2b@tax_table[colnames(pos_r2b@otu_table), c("family", "genus")]
# Zymo bact Mock, of 8 bact spp. (+2 fungal yeasts) was used; but 19 tax not 8, and not as evenly amplified
# Bacillus 37, 445
# Enterococcus 53, 689
# Escherichia 50, 626 
# Lactobacillus 43, 471
# Listeria 45, 568
# Pseudomonas 82, 1369, 3128
# Salmonella 6, 120, 345 are Enterobacteriaceae and BLAST match Salmonella
# Staphylococcus 41, 511
# # likely that ASV3:Erwiniaceae w/ 20 reads is contaminant that was not removed during SCRuB
ps_r2b@otu_table[,"bASV3"]  #in lots of things, most much > than 20 reads, 16 samples 19 reads or less

pos_r2f <- subset_samples(ps_r2f, Chamber.Rep == "")
pos_r2f <- filter_taxa(pos_r2f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )
pos_r2f@otu_table 
pos_r2f@tax_table[colnames(pos_r2f@otu_table), c("family", "genus")]
# Bakker Fungal Mock Even mix of 19spp was used; but 26 not 19, and not really evenly amplified
# 1, 68 = alternaria, 205,268, 296 & 2 more unk Glomeromycota likely Rhizophagus; 
# 3 Fusarium ASVs & also supposed to be 3 fusarium in mock
# unk Ceratobasidiaceae likely Rhizoctonia, also an unk Ascomycota that might be one of the missing Ascos
# 58 Podila not in mock (this Podila might be the Mortierella in Bakker's orig); 
# 63 Starmerella not in mock, could this be a mis-IDed Candida?
# in mock but not amplified [Ascos: Neosartorya, Candida], [Zygos: Mortierella, Rhizomucor]
# likely that fASV21:Vishniacozyma w/ 21 reads is contaminant that was not removed during SCRuB
ps_r2f@otu_table[,"fASV21"]  # only in 2 other samples: J-Tw-12-R2-F & J-PH1-02-R2-F, could just remove this ASV, would not hurt anything. Potentially from lab-bench
```

### Remove Mocks
* and contaminants
```{r, results = 'hide'}
ps_r1b <- subset_samples(ps_r1b, Chamber.Rep != "Control")
ps_r1b <- filter_taxa(ps_r1b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) # removes 1 taxa unique to pos.cont.

ps_r1f <- subset_samples(ps_r1f, Chamber.Rep != "Control")
ps_r1f <- filter_taxa(ps_r1f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) # removes 21 taxa unique to mock

ps_r2b <- subset_samples(ps_r2b, Chamber.Rep != "")
ps_r2b <- filter_taxa(ps_r2b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) # removes 14 taxa unique to mock 
out <- as(otu_table(ps_r2b)[,"bASV3"], "matrix")
otu_table(ps_r2b)[,"bASV3"] <- ifelse(out>20, out-20, 0)

ps_r2f <- subset_samples(ps_r2f, Chamber.Rep != "")
ps_r2f <- filter_taxa(ps_r2f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) # removes 20 taxa unique to mock
ps_r2f <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_r2f) != "fASV21", ps_r2f) # remove likely contaminant Vishniacozyma found in mock

```

* r1b - B-H-T5-1-4,  B-H-T5-1-3, & B-H-T5-1-12 #these 3 samples did not asymptote or come close
* r1f - 10 samples below 51 reads; everything > 51 reads either asymptotes, or only has 1 ASV (Fusarium) and no good way to judge if it asymptotes. All low depth samples are Tween treatment.
* r2b - all asymptoted, even the low depth
* r2f - all asymptoted
* for fungi, definitely a depth bias by the Tween treatment group, in both rounds


### Remove Low Depth Samples
```{r, results = 'hide'}
prune_r1b <- c("B-H-T5-1-4", "B-H-T5-1-3", "B-H-T5-1-12")
ps_r1b <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps_r1b) %nin% prune_r1b, ps_r1b)
ps_r1b <- filter_taxa(ps_r1b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )  # 4 taxa removed

prune_r1f <- names(sort(rowSums(otu_table(ps_r1f)))[1:10])
ps_r1f <- prune_samples(sample_names(ps_r1f) %nin% prune_r1f, ps_r1f)
ps_r1f <- filter_taxa(ps_r1f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE )  # 4 taxa removed

```


# Reorder & Rename ASVs
* Merge by kingdom, then reorder ASVs by abundance and rename to smaller ASVs numbers unique to this project and not inclusive of the HackFlex test or Barley endos project.
```{r, include = FALSE}
#### Bacteria
#identical(as.character(ps_r1b@refseq[1,]), as.character(ps_r2b@refseq[1,]))
ps_r1b@sam_data$Round <- as.factor("R1")
ps_r2b@sam_data$Round <- as.factor("R2")
ps_b0 <-  merge_phyloseq(ps_r1b, ps_r2b)
ps_b0

# make sequences the names of the ps objects
dna_b0 <- data.frame(name = names(ps_b0@refseq), seq = unname(as.character(ps_b0@refseq)))
taxa_names(ps_b0) <- dna_b0$seq[ match(taxa_names(ps_b0), dna_b0$name) ]
ps_b0

#reorder taxa by abundance
abunOrder_b <- names(sort(colSums(ps_b0@otu_table), decreasing = TRUE))
abundances_b <- unname(sort(colSums(ps_b0@otu_table), decreasing = TRUE))
ps_b0@otu_table <- ps_b0@otu_table[, abunOrder_b]
ps_b0@tax_table <- ps_b0@tax_table[abunOrder_b, ]
ps_b0@refseq <- ps_b0@refseq[names(ps_b0@refseq)[match(abunOrder_b, names(ps_b0@refseq))] ]

#rename taxa
ps_b <- ps_b0
taxa_names(ps_b) <- paste0("ASV", seq(1,length(taxa_names(ps_b))))
#identical(unname(colSums(ps_b@otu_table)), abundances_b) #sanity check
ps_b

#### Fungi
#identical(as.character(ps_r1f@refseq[1,]), as.character(ps_r2f@refseq[1,]))
ps_r1f@sam_data$Round <- as.factor("R1")
ps_r2f@sam_data$Round <- as.factor("R2")
ps_f0 <-  merge_phyloseq(ps_r1f, ps_r2f)
ps_f0

# make sequences the names of the ps objects
dna_f0 <- data.frame(name = names(ps_f0@refseq), seq = unname(as.character(ps_f0@refseq)))
taxa_names(ps_f0) <- dna_f0$seq[ match(taxa_names(ps_f0), dna_f0$name) ]
ps_f0

#reorder taxa by abundance
abunOrder_f <- names(sort(colSums(ps_f0@otu_table), decreasing = TRUE))
abundances_f <- unname(sort(colSums(ps_f0@otu_table), decreasing = TRUE))
ps_f0@otu_table <- ps_f0@otu_table[, abunOrder_f]
ps_f0@tax_table <- ps_f0@tax_table[abunOrder_f, ]
ps_f0@refseq <- ps_f0@refseq[names(ps_f0@refseq)[match(abunOrder_f, names(ps_f0@refseq))] ]

#rename taxa
ps_f <- ps_f0
taxa_names(ps_f) <- paste0("ASV", seq(1,length(taxa_names(ps_f))))
#identical(unname(colSums(ps_f@otu_table)), abundances_f) #sanity check
ps_f
```

# Look at Disease Data
```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.keep = 'all', fig.height = 4, fig.width =4}
# disease symptoms measured at the head level
disHeads_r1 <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_R1_diseaseHeads.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
disHeads_r1$Head <- as.factor(disHeads_r1$Head)
disHeads_r1 <- disHeads_r1[disHeads_r1$Notes == "",] # remove non-harvested head

disHeads_r2 <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_R2_diseaseHeads.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
disHeads_r2$Head <- as.factor(disHeads_r2$Head)
disHeads_r2 <- disHeads_r2[disHeads_r2$Notes == "",] # remove non-harvested heads

ggplot(disHeads_r1, aes(x = Chamber, y = disP.d7, fill = Strain)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)
ggplot(disHeads_r1, aes(x = Chamber, y = head.mass.g, fill = Strain)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)

ggplot(disHeads_r2, aes(x = Chamber, y = disP.d7, fill = Strain)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)
ggplot(disHeads_r2, aes(x = Chamber, y = head.mass.g, fill = Strain)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)


# disease symptoms measured at the tube level (also matches Microbiome data)
disTubes_r1 <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_R1_diseaseTubes.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
disTubes_r1$TubeNum <- as.factor(disTubes_r1$TubeNum)
disTubes_r1$Notes <- as.factor(disTubes_r1$Notes)
rownames(disTubes_r1) <- disTubes_r1$B_ID
disTubes_r2 <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_R2_diseaseTubes.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
disTubes_r2$TubeNum <- as.factor(disTubes_r2$TubeNum)
disTubes_r2 <- disTubes_r2[disTubes_r2$Notes == "",] # remove tubes with contamination from outside
rownames(disTubes_r2) <- disTubes_r2$B_ID


ggplot(disTubes_r1, aes(x = Chamber, y = ugDON_per_g, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)
ggplot(disTubes_r1, aes(x = Chamber, y = FgTa_ratio, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)


ggplot(disTubes_r2, aes(x = Chamber, y = ugDON_per_g, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)
ggplot(disTubes_r2, aes(x = Chamber, y = FgTa_ratio, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col)

# drop columns
disTubes_r1 %>% dplyr::select(B_ID, F_ID, HeadNumsInTube, Fg_gm, Ta_gm, FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g, Notes) -> disTubes_r1
disTubes_r2 %>% dplyr::select(B_ID, F_ID, HeadNumsInTube, Fg_gm, Ta_gm, FgTa_ratio, ugDON_per_g, Notes) -> disTubes_r2

```

### Merge diseease data to ps
```{r, include = FALSE}
rm(ps_r1b, ps_r1f, ps_r2b, ps_r2f)

#unmerge by round
ps_r1b <- subset_samples(ps_b, ps_b@sam_data$Round == "R1")
ps_r1b <- filter_taxa(ps_r1b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) 
ps_r2b <- subset_samples(ps_b, ps_b@sam_data$Round == "R2")
ps_r2b <- filter_taxa(ps_r2b, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) 

ps_r1f <- subset_samples(ps_f, ps_f@sam_data$Round == "R1")
ps_r1f <- filter_taxa(ps_r1f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) 
ps_r2f <- subset_samples(ps_f, ps_f@sam_data$Round == "R2")
ps_r2f <- filter_taxa(ps_r2f, function(x) mean(x) > 0, TRUE ) 

# sanity checks
table(ps_r1b@sam_data$Sample_ID %in% disTubes_r1$B_ID)
table(ps_r1f@sam_data$Sample_ID %in% disTubes_r1$F_ID)
table(ps_r2b@sam_data$Sample_ID %in% disTubes_r2$B_ID)
table(ps_r2f@sam_data$Sample_ID %in% disTubes_r2$F_ID)

# merge disease data
SbyE_r1b <- merge( as(sample_data(ps_r1b), "data.frame"), disTubes_r1, 
      by.x = "Sample_ID", by.y = "B_ID")
rownames(SbyE_r1b) <- SbyE_r1b$Sample_ID
sample_data(ps_r1b) <- sample_data(SbyE_r1b)
SbyE_r1f <- merge( as(sample_data(ps_r1f), "data.frame"), disTubes_r1, 
      by.x = "Sample_ID", by.y = "F_ID")
rownames(SbyE_r1f) <- SbyE_r1f$Sample_ID
sample_data(ps_r1f) <- sample_data(SbyE_r1f)

SbyE_r2b <- merge( as(sample_data(ps_r2b), "data.frame"), disTubes_r2, 
      by.x = "Sample_ID", by.y = "B_ID")
rownames(SbyE_r2b) <- SbyE_r2b$Sample_ID
sample_data(ps_r2b) <- sample_data(SbyE_r2b)
SbyE_r2f <- merge( as(sample_data(ps_r2f), "data.frame"), disTubes_r2, 
      by.x = "Sample_ID", by.y = "F_ID")
rownames(SbyE_r2f) <- SbyE_r2f$Sample_ID
sample_data(ps_r2f) <- sample_data(SbyE_r2f)
```
